hero.title: Run your library, beautifully.
hero.subtitle: Libriant brings your catalog, members, and everyday lending into one calm, modern workspace — so you spend less time wrestling software and more time with readers.
hero.note: No credit card needed. Set up in minutes.
features.title: Everything your library needs
features.subtitle: From the front desk to the back office, in one place.
features.catalog.title: A catalog that's a joy to build
features.catalog.body: Add books by ISBN and let Libriant fill in the details, or enter them by hand. Search, organise, and find anything in seconds.
features.circulation.title: Effortless circulation
features.circulation.body: Check books out and back in, track due dates, and handle renewals — the everyday flow that keeps your shelves moving.
features.members.title: Members at your fingertips
features.members.body: Keep patron records, contact details, and borrowing history tidy and one click away.
features.reservations.title: Holds & reservations
features.reservations.body: Staff place holds on a member’s behalf. The queue keeps priority order, and the moment a copy comes back the first person is moved to ready for pickup.
features.import.title: Bring your data with you
features.import.body: Move from another system in an afternoon — import your catalog, members, and live loans from CSV, Excel, or MARC.
features.bilingual.title: English & Greek, out of the box
features.bilingual.body: Libriant speaks your language. Switch between English and Greek anywhere, instantly.
cta.title: Ready to give your library a home?
cta.body: Create your library in a few minutes — it's free to start.
